description: Source code for a tool that encrypts and decrypts uImage formatted firmware for Hilink HLK-RM04 modules, including functions for file handling, encryption/decryption, and header validation.

classes.name: image_header_t
classes.description: Structure representing the header of a firmware image, including magic number, CRCs, size, load address, entry point, and metadata.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: exit_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as temporary files on program exit.

methods.name: copy_file
methods.description: Copies data from a source file descriptor to a destination file descriptor.

methods.name: do_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data in-place using DES ECB mode.

methods.name: do_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data in-place using DES ECB mode.
